{{Quote|Have you noticed that the price of dianogan tea has risen considerably since we broke the Treaty of Coruscant?|Eckard Lokin|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Dianogan [[Tea/Legends|tea]]''' was a steeped beverage brewed from chemicals found in the [[spleen]] of the [[Dianoga/Legends|dianoga]]. It was normally served hot. Dianogan tea was considered something of a delicacy by [[Muun/Legends|Muuns]], despite the fact that it temporarily stained the lips and teeth of those who drank it [[Color/Legends|purple]] and black respectively. The tea had a mild narcotic effect.

[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Pors Tonith]], [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] invader of [[Praesitlyn/Legends|Praesitlyn]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], was a fancier of dianogan tea.
